description: This PHP class defines a service for migrating meeting synchronization data from a legacy system with gsync_id/gsync_lastsync fields to a new calendar account meetings table within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for validation, data retrieval, creation of new migration records, and cleanup of legacy data.

classes.name: MeetingMigrationService
classes.description: Service class that manages the process of migrating legacy meeting sync data to a new system, including validation, data transformation, and database operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database and logger dependencies required for the migration operations.

methods.name: validateMeetingMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the necessary tables exist before performing migration.

methods.name: migrateMeetingSyncData
methods.description: Main method to perform migration of meetings with legacy sync data to the new calendar account meetings system.

methods.name: findMeetingsWithGoogleSync
methods.description: Retrieves legacy meeting records with Google sync data for migration.

methods.name: findCalendarAccountForUser
methods.description: Finds associated calendar account for a user based on user ID.

methods.name: hasExistingCalendarAccountMeeting
methods.description: Checks if a migration record already exists for a given meeting and account.

methods.name: createCalendarAccountMeeting
methods.description: Creates new calendar account meeting record from legacy data unless in dry run mode.

methods.name: cleanupLegacyMeetingSync
methods.description: Removes legacy sync fields from the meeting after successful migration.
